Dev.//RolesWhenAbsent: What a dev-auth caller who sends NO X-Dev-Roles header gets. The platform's default is system_admin, for a smooth first run; here it is deliberately nothing. A header-stripping proxy, a copy-pasted curl or a forgotten header must DEGRADE a caller, never escalate one — a compliance product cannot have 'I forgot a header' mean 'I am the operator'. Proved by the kit's S09. Every committed caller sends the header explicitly (RUNBOOK §3, DevAuthHeaderConventionTests), so nothing in this repo relies on the default.
